title: Have You Tried Reading the Paper?
description: An open, bilingual (English and Brazilian Portuguese) engineering reference for understanding modern foundation models below the interface layer. The project connects representations, tensors, objectives, architectures, inference, runtime, training, evaluation, retrieval, multimodality, agents, world models, security, and failure modes through equations, system-level relationships, and implementation-aware datasheets. The knowledge base is human-directed and AI-assisted; detailed production provenance is documented in PROVENANCE.md.
